text:
Anna: quick sync — PR #482 adds an autoscale example for dedicated pools but I think the preemption wording is off. can someone review?
Jake: on it. which file? i saw a change in docs/dedicated/provisioning.md
Anna: yes. new section 'Autoscale policies -> preemption' — we shouldn't say 'guaranteed no preemption' anywhere; that's not true for burst pools.
Sofia: tagging infra: @jake @matt — we need an explicit line about reserved vs burst pools and preemption semantics. maybe a small table?
Jake: agreed. suggest: short bullet + example policy. i pushed a proposed snippet to the PR:
```hcl
resource "redwood_dedicated_pool" "fast" {
  name = "fast"
  capacity = 10
  scale_policy {
    min = 2
    max = 20
    mode = "conservative"
    preemptible = true
  }
}
```
Anna: that looks good. can we also add a migration note for customers moving from hosted -> dedicated: what breaks (networking, encryption keys, per-tenant quotas)?
Matt: from product: add migration checklist link and SLA callouts. SLA change: dedicated gets 99.9% but isolation failures are regional. wording needs legal sign-off.
Anna: ok i'll add a "migration-notes" subsection and link to the checklist. need a short sentence about SLA scope: "SLA applies to uptime of dedicated serving, excluding customer network and force majeure" — is that acceptable?
Sofia: sounds fine as draft. legal will tweak. also we must add SDK snippets for creating pools via python SDK.
Jake: here's a quick py snippet to include:
```python
from redwood import DedicatedClient
client = DedicatedClient()
client.create_pool(name="fast", capacity=10, scale_policy={"min":2,"max":20,"mode":"conservative"})
```
Anna: perfect — will add under "examples -> SDK". also found two broken links in that doc (internal: /docs/dedicated/old-onboard and external to a Terraform module). i fixed links in a followup commit.
docs-ci-bot: PR #482 checks: link-check failed on /docs/dedicated/old-onboard -> 404
Anna: thanks CI. replaced with /docs/dedicated/onboarding-checklist
Jake: one last ask: could we add a short note about isolation decorators (tenant annotations) and example annotation name? e.g., `isolation: "tenant:acme-inc"`
Sofia: yes, add example and note about eviction semantics.
Matt: i'll loop legal and support. ETA EOD for review?
Anna: thanks everyone — i'll update PR with snippets/links and ping when ready :thumbsup: 
Jake: :shipit: once legal signs off
Anna: merged after legal review.
